Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**THE RECORD BREAKER**

FADE IN:

INT. WORLD RECORD OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and camera crews. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Pleasure To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live, Held By The Incomparable Jasper Jenkins!

Jasper Steps Up To The Podium, A Look Of Pride On His Face. The Crowd Erupts In Cheers And Applause As He Accepts The Plaque.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper Lies In Bed, The Plaque From Earlier Displayed On His Nightstand. He Looks Up At The Ceiling, A Faraway Look In His Eyes.

JASPER (V.O)
I Remember Reading About This Theory Online, Back In The Day. Quantum Immortality. It Said That If You Were Born, You Would Live Forever. That You Would Be Trapped In A Never-Ending Loop Of Birth, Death, And Rebirth.

Jasper's Voice Becomes More Urgent, His Words Spilling Out In A Rush.

JASPER (V.O)
I THOUGHT IT WAS JUST A JOKE. A FANCY TERM FOR THE CYCLE OF LIFE. BUT NOW... NOW I REALIZE IT'S REAL. I'M THE PROOF.

Jasper's Eyes Glaze Over, His Mind Racing With The Implications.

JASPER (V.O)
I'M NOT JUST A RECORD-HOLDER. I'M A TIME LOOP. A LOOPING TIME LOOP. FOREVER.

Jasper's Voice Drops To A Whisper, His Body Shaking With Sobs.

JASPER (V.O)
I'M TRAPPED. TRAPPED IN THIS NEVER-ENDING CYCLE. BORN, LIVE, DIE, REBORN. FOREVER.

The Camera Zooms In On Jasper's Face, His Eyes Wild With Desperation.

JASPER (V.O)
I DON'T WANT TO LIVE FOREVER. I WANT TO BE FREE.

Jasper's Body Begins To Shake More Intensely, His Sobs Growing Louder.

JASPER (V.O)
I'M GOING TO BREAK. I'M GOING TO BREAK THE CYCLE. I'M GOING TO...

Jasper's Voice Fades Away, Replaced By The Sound Of His Own Sobs. The Camera Continues To Zoom In, Capturing The Desperation And Madness In Jasper's Eyes.

FADE TO BLACK.

**THE END**
